name: Nabassu Gargoyle

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Bloodfire
traits.details: While the gargoyle is affected by stone form, whenever any enemy ends its turn in the aura, the gargoyle gains 10 temporary hit points and the enemy takes 10 fire and necrotic damage.

auras.name: Bloodfire
auras.details: While the gargoyle is affected by stone form, whenever any enemy ends its turn in the aura, the gargoyle gains 10 temporary hit points and the enemy takes 10 fire and necrotic damage.

effect.description: The gargoyle gains tremorsense 10 and resist 35 to all damage until it uses a minor action to end this effect. While in this form, the gargoyle cannot take actions except to end the effect. When the gargoyle ends this effect, each enemy within 3 squares of it takes 2d10 + 10 fire and necrotic damage.
